basics.name: Obed Junias
basics.label: Computer Science Graduate Student & NLP Researcher
basics.summary:
I am a graduate researcher exploring Commonsense Reasoning, Neuro-symbolic NLP, and Responsible ML. My research focuses on developing reasoning frameworks that integrate structured logic with neural repre-
sentations, with the goal of improving the interpretability, factual consistency, and fairness of LLMs. I aspire to
contribute to foundational AI research at the intersection of cognition, reasoning, and ethical deployment.

work.name: Oracle Corporation
work.summary: Architected and implemented TestNG and BATS automation frameworks for Oracle Rest Data Services and SQLcL, reducing manual effort by 95%. Engineered Python-based migration framework for Oracle APEX applications supporting 200+ employees.
highlights: Led 15-member team for DB Tools feature validation

work.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
work.summary: Built intelligent automation solution with Groovy and Workfusion OCR, optimizing data workflows and integrating text extraction into software robots, increasing speed by 40% and reducing errors by 80%.
highlights: Delivered PoC on Intelligent Business Process Management

volunteer.organization: Institute of Cognitive Science, CU Boulder
volunteer.summary: Conducting bias and fairness evaluation in LLaMA, GPT-4, and other LLMs for mental health NLP tasks, analyzing demographic and linguistic biases across multi-modal datasets.
highlights: Implemented fairness metrics for LLM evaluation
Identified biases in pronoun usage and emotional tone

publications.name: Assessing Algorithmic Bias in Language-Based Depression Detection: A Comparison of DNN and LLM Approaches
publications.publisher: IEEE-EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI)
publications.summary: Research paper investigating algorithmic bias in language-based depression detection systems, comparing deep neural network and large language model approaches for fair and responsible AI in mental health applications.

projects.name: Medical Ethics Assessment of LLMs
projects.summary: Systematic assessment of ethical reasoning capabilities of large language models in clinical contexts using RAG pipeline and controlled evaluation with curated multiple-choice questions.

projects.name: Lost in Plot: Contrastive Learning for Movie Retrieval
projects.summary: Dense retrieval system using fine-tuned BERT encoder with contrastive learning for tip-of-the-tongue movie retrieval, outperforming GPT-4 baseline on 100K+ movie corpus.

projects.name: Resource-Efficient LLM Fine-tuning for Mental Health Support
projects.summary: Applied parameter-efficient fine-tuning with QLoRA to adapt Falcon 7B model for mental health conversations with limited computational resources.

projects.name: Multi-stage RAG System
projects.summary: Robust RAG system with FAISS indexing and Scikit-Learn context filtering for enhanced factual grounding of LLM responses over research paper corpus.
